description: Land Title Settlement Department - Palapatha, Beliatha D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 330119
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names and addresses, title classifications, and other land-related particulars. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
